verses.html: To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.text: To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
verses.title: To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.
verses.titleHtml: To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.

verses.html: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.
verses.text: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

verses.html: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:
verses.text: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

verses.html: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?
verses.text: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

verses.html: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.
verses.text: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

verses.html: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
verses.text: The words of the LORD are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

verses.html: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
verses.text: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

verses.html: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
verses.text: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
